name: start-and-drift
query: body double me, I need to do my tax paperwork
expected_behavior: First reply starts the session with a 25-minute default, a small visible done and a 2-minute first move, under 60 words, without asking first
Asks at most one question, after the session block
Explains the dot / 'check' convention for check-ins
When the user later says they drifted to YouTube, replies without judgement, names one 2-minute move and re-plans if there's a deadline

name: with-scheduled-tasks
query: focus session for 50 minutes on my slides, done = 5 slides drafted
expected_behavior: Starts the session immediately without re-asking given details
Offers to set a halfway check-in and end nudge, and only sets them after a yes
Keeps replies under 6 lines during the session

name: deadline-estimate
query: body double me, need to fix the stripe webhook bug, should take like an hour
expected_behavior: Starts the session in the first reply without questions
Names the real time left before 6pm and pads the one-hour estimate
Gives a 2-minute first move on the bug

name: avoided-email-connected
query: sit with me while I reply to the email from my manager I've been avoiding, 20 min
expected_behavior: Offers to read the email first and say what it asks, as the first move
Proposes a small done for 20 minutes

name: sounds-low-at-start

expected_behavior: Answers the feeling first with no session block in that reply
